C.promptVariant: RPG Maker MV map phrasing; camera block: A screenshot of an RPG Maker MV game map, 2D top-down overworld exactly like Pokémon FireRed / LeafGreen or Stardew Valley town: the camera looks straight down at the ground from above, ORTHOGRAPHIC, no perspective, no vanishing point, no isometric diagonals, no horizon, no sky. Buildings are drawn the way 2D RPG tilesets draw them: a flat rooftop seen from above at the top, and the building's front facade (doors, windows, shop signs) drawn as a flat vertical strip directly beneath the roof, facing the player. The street runs horizontally left-to-right across the bottom third of the frame. Everything sits on a visible 32-pixel square tile grid; crisp square pixels, 16-bit pixel art, no anti-aliasing, no blur, clean 1px dark outlines.

prompt: Pixel art game screenshot, 16-bit style, top-down 3/4 perspective like an RPG Maker or Stardew Valley town street, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no dithering, clean 1-pixel dark outlines on every object. Scene: a real Bangalore, India residential lane at morning. Left: a narrow 3-storey independent house, exposed red brick and cream plaster, iron grille balconies, a black Sintex water tank on the flat roof, a tangle of overhead electric cables. Centre: a small "Darshini" standing eatery with a steel counter, a painted red-and-yellow signboard reading HOTEL DARSHINI, steel tumblers and an idli steamer, two plastic stools. Right: a provision store with sachets hanging in strips and a blue plastic drum. Foreground: a tar road with patch repairs and a white speed breaker, a black-and-yellow auto rickshaw parked, a broken paver-block footpath, a rain tree with leaf litter, a green BBMP dustbin, a stray dog. Characters: two Indian pedestrians in chibi proportions (big head, small body, about 1 tile wide and 1.5 tiles tall), a young man in a light-blue formal shirt with a backpack and a young woman in a kurti with a sling bag, both with clean 1px dark outlines, wheatish skin. Palette: warm, slightly desaturated earth tones — brick red, cream, ochre, tar grey, rain-tree green, auto yellow — soft warm shadows, morning haze, a limited palette of about 48 colours. Everything grid-aligned to 32-pixel tiles. No text except the Darshini board, no real brand logos, no watermark, no UI.

nextStep: User picks C or D (or corrects). On approval: copy winner → style/style_sheet.png, its .gpl → palette.gpl, status 'locked', remove other candidates, AUDIT_LOG entry, then P2.
promptRules: State the camera explicitly AND negatively (orthographic, straight down, no perspective/vanishing point/isometric/horizon).
Describe buildings as 'flat roof on top + facade as a flat band beneath' — image models otherwise invent a side wall.
Street runs left→right on a 32px grid; name a real game (RPG Maker MV, FireRed/LeafGreen, Stardew) as the camera anchor.
